doc_title_en: Notice of Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase) for FY3/27
doc_title_jp: 配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 通期の連結業績予想が前回予想を上回る見通し

summary_en: Annual dividend FY3/27 raised to ¥105/share (¥52.50 interim, ¥52.50 year-end) from prior guidance of ¥90/share. Increase of ¥15/share reflects upgraded full-year earnings forecast. Consolidated payout ratio target maintained at 30%+.
summary_jp: FY3/27年間配当を¥90/株から¥105/株に修正（中間¥52.50、期末¥52.50）。通期業績予想上方修正に伴う増配。連結配当性向30%以上を維持。
tag_en: Dividend hike – ¥105/share (¥52.50 interim + ¥52.50 year-end) FY3/27 – +¥15/share vs prior guidance
